On Mon, 26 Apr 2027 at 09:12, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick note: during last week's forecast run there were a few deals where "Commit" vs "Best Case" looked inconsistent (notably RDW-4521).

Thanks for doing the initial pass, Markus. A few operational clarifications from Sales Ops that we will cover in the microclinic:
- "Commit" requires active verbal alignment with the buyer + procurement timeline in the same quarter (explicit date or confirmed week)
- "Best Case" can include deals with a trial in progress but no explicit procurement timeline; probability should be lowered if legal not engaged
- For multi-product deals, use the lowest-confidence product to determine category (i.e., conservative approach)

I attached a slide set with the quick call script and three RDW-4521-specific examples we should roleplay. Please review before Wed.
